title: Slovakian Pork Dumplings
description: A hearty Slovakian dish featuring tender pork served with homemade dumplings.
instructions: In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
In a separate bowl, mix together the dumpling flour, egg, and a pinch of salt.
Roll out the dumpling mixture to about 1cm thickness.
Cut the dumplings into desired shape (e.g., squares or circles).
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the dumplings for 5-7 minutes, or until they float.
Serve the pork with the cooked dumplings and garnish with chopped fresh parsley, if desired.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in the pan and fry the cooked dumplings until crispy.
Serve the fried dumplings on top of the pork and enjoy!
